subsystem.name: RuntimeObjectUtils
subsystem.responsibility: A loose set of runtime utility objects and helpers in the 0x499xxx-0x49Cxxx range: string-copy delegate forwarders, twin/quad dword field accessors, a string-keyed bucket table (with 28-byte nodes and next-link at +24), an indexed 16-bit linked-list accessor (head at +0, cursor at +8, length at +0xC), scroll/rectangle region state writers, HUD/debug text formatters driven by a global post-process input state, and a vehicle lap/time gap calculator.

summary: Proposal groups 30 validated functions into 15 weakly-typed classes plus unresolved free helpers. The strongest evidence links are the string-keyed bucket table (lookup 0x0049A360, insert 0x0049A3B0, membership 0x0049A520, 26-bucket destructor 0x0049A2F0, all sharing the node next-link at +24) and the indexed 16-bit linked list (read 0x0049AEC0, write 0x0049AE40, two-channel read 0x00499F00, sharing head/cursor/length layout). The HUD text formatters (0x0049BFF0, 0x0049C280, 0x0049C310, 0x0049C370, 0x0049C490, 0x0049C4E0, 0x0049C8A0) all consume a global post-process input object behind dword_7C54E0. Three identical single-call forwarders to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc form a behavioral group. Most owners remain GUESS/UNKNOWN; no class assignment implies confirmed C++ ownership.

function_roles.role: stdcall single-call delegate forwarding its one argument to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and returning the helper's result unchanged
stdcall single-call forwarder delegating its one argument to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and returning its result unchanged
clamps two arguments to non-negative and stores max(a2,0) at this+0x60 and max(a3,0) at this+0x64; returns the original a3
copies the two consecutive DWORD fields this+0x60 and this+0x64 into output pointers a2/a3 and returns the second field value

gated two-channel 16-bit list read: proceeds only when ShortComputation_adb0(this+0x6C) is > 2, then publishes two shorts per channel via LinkedListIndexedFieldReader(0) and (1), each gated on a nonzero read result
zeroes the first dword (offset 0x0) of an object and returns the this pointer; generic per-field zero-init helper

conditional head store with chain iteration: rejects zero a2 (-1), lazily stores a2 as list head at this+0x0 when head is NULL, otherwise walks the chain via sub_499E00 and invokes FieldSetterAt0x68 on a traversed node
initializes seven consecutive dword fields (0x0..0x18) with the alternating pattern 0,-1,0,-1,0,-1,0 and returns this; ctor_init-style node initializer used on a fresh 28-byte allocation
stdcall single-call forwarder delegating its one argument to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and returning its result unchanged; shared by ResourceLookupOrCreate and StringReverseCopyLookup
destructor draining 26 singly-linked buckets this[0..25]: per node reads next at node index 6 (offset 24), runs sub_49A270 teardown, frees via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and zeroes each bucket head
bucket-chain string lookup by normalized key: CharToIndexConversion bucket index, walks the node chain at node+24 comparing each node string via sub_588410; returns matching node or 0

validates and inserts a string-keyed node: normalize via sub_589901, reject on sub_49A520 failure, CharToIndexConversion index, allocate 28-byte node, PatternedFieldInit, process string/a3, then link the node at this[index] (appending to list tail via the +24 next pointer)

string-keyed membership lookup: normalize, CharToIndexConversion index (-1 -> return -1), bucket head null -> 0, node-string comparison via sub_588410 returning 1 on match, 0 when the chain is exhausted
initializes a 7-dword object: zeros offsets 0x0,0x4,0xC,0x14,0x18 and sets sentinel -1 at offsets 0x8,0x10; returns the object pointer
constructor installing vtable off_5ACAB0 at +0, initializing the sub-object at dword index 9 via ThunkToFUN00491330, zeroing +4..+10 and +34/+3C, and filling +14..+20 and +38 with the -1 sentinel
computes rectangle edge offsets relative to the reference point at this+0x4/+0xC, writing left/top/right/bottom into +0x14/+0x18/+0x1C/+0x20 and returning the relative bottom edge
writes four caller-supplied parameters into consecutive dword fields +0x14/+0x18/+0x1C/+0x20 and returns the fourth parameter; straight-line writer with no reads

applies scroll offsets to the four extent fields +0x4/+0x8/+0xC/+0x10 with 16-bit overflow-aware clamping; when the +0x40 render flag is set obtains the render surface via Accessor() and calls RenderSurfaceFillCopy, then accumulates the raw offsets and returns this[4]

writes two 16-bit values (a3,a4) into the list entry at index a2: appends via ObjectConstructor_adc0 when a2 equals the length from ShortComputation_adb0, otherwise walks the node chain from this+0x0 (next at node+4) and writes the payload slots

reads two 16-bit values from the list node at index a2 into *a3/*a4: bounds-checks against the length at this+0xC, seeds the cursor this+0x8 at the head, walks the node chain, and copies the node payload words (zeroing outputs and returning 0 on any invalid node)

computes the time and lap gap between two vehicle objects: reads lap counters at +0x403C and times via sub_4F01B0(+12); equal laps -> signed time gap, one-lap wrap with v9<v7 -> flt_5EA408-v7+v9, otherwise lap difference with decrement
session-mode predicate: returns true only when the dword at dword_7C54E0+0x3450 is in the range 1..3

formats the next lap time into a HUD/replay buffer: computes the next lap index at dword_7C54E0+16448 (wrapping 2->0), copies prefix asc_5CCE18, selects ghost (flt_5F0780[4656*index+lap], via sub_4D1B50) or race-struct (dword_7C54E0+4*lap+16552) time source, and appends " %.2d:%06.3f" when positive

formats one of three circular-recorded times on the post-process input object into the caller buffer: next circular index at dword_7C54E0+16448, reads float at +4*index+16552, appends " MM:SS.FFF" when positive; always returns 0

formats a debug label with a name from a global object: copies prefix asc_5CCE54, and unless the flag at dword_7C54E0+16484 is set, reads the pointer at +16592 and appends "%s:" from v3+18168 then emits via sub_589901

formats the time or lap-count gap to a target object into HUD text: seeds prefix asc_5CCE54, bails on suppression/target guards, then either fabs+SpatialGridCell "-%.2d:%06.3f" (behind) or a pluralized " -%d %s" via the string table in byte_5EC4CC (ahead)
copies prefix asc_5CCE54 into the output buffer and, unless the flag at dword_7C54E0+16484 is set, appends the name at (dword_7C54E0+16596)+18168 as "%s:"; always returns 0

formats the signed gap to a target object into HUD text: seed prefix, target at dword_7C54E0+16596, LapTimeGapCalculation; v7<=0 renders "+MM:SS.FFF" via fabs+SpatialGridCell, else " +N %s" with pluralizer chosen by off_5CCE74/aLaps_0 through the string table
formats the championship score threshold: ChampionshipScoreThresholdSearch on dword_7C54E0+13004; renders the integer when positive, otherwise the placeholder word_5C694C; always returns 0

HUD speed readout: selects SpeedMagnitude (0x0049B900) or SpeedMagnitude_b950 (0x0049B950) on byte_7D0474, formats the magnitude as "%.3d" into a stack buffer, and renders it through sub_553070 to the display resource at this+0x10

classes.name: StringCopyForwarder
classes.responsibility: Behavioral group of three __stdcall single-call forwarders that each delegate their single argument to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and return its result unchanged. Grouped by identical body shape; not proven to share an owning object.

classes.name: DwordFieldPairAccessor
classes.responsibility: Accessor pair over two consecutive DWORD fields at +0x60/+0x64: a clamped setter (negative inputs become 0) and a getter copying both fields out. Common ownership of the base is GUESS (callers differ: 0x00493060 vs 0x004861A0); only offset usage is evidenced.

classes.name: StringHashTable
classes.responsibility: String-keyed bucket table of singly-linked nodes: key normalization, char-to-bucket-index conversion, lookup/membership/insert, a 26-bucket destructor, and the shared node next-link at +24. The 26-bucket count is direct evidence from the destructor; that CharToIndexConversion's range equals 0..25 is GUESS.

classes.name: StringHashNode
classes.responsibility: 28-byte singly-linked node of the string table: key string at +0, next link at +24, initialized with the alternating 0/-1 pattern. The +4..+14 fields are written only by the initializer and never read within this packet.

classes.name: IndexedListAccessor
classes.responsibility: Linked list with head at +0, traversal cursor at +8, length at +0xC and nodes linked through the next pointer at node+4; supports indexed 16-bit-pair read/write and a gated two-channel read. Layout is cross-corroborated by 0x0049AE40 and 0x0049AEC0.

classes.name: IndexedListNode
classes.responsibility: Node of the indexed list: data pointer at +0 (holding two 16-bit payload values) and next-node link at +4. No packet function is a node method; layout is inferred from the two walkers.

classes.name: ScrollOffsetState
classes.responsibility: Scroll/region state with four extent dwords at +4/+8/+C/+10 updated by accumulated offsets, a render flag at +0x40, and an optional render-surface fill-copy path.

classes.name: RectangleRegionState
classes.responsibility: Rectangle region with reference coordinates at +4/+C and four computed relative edge offsets at +14/+18/+1C/+20. Corner/axis semantics are inferred from prose, not independently evidenced.

classes.name: QuadDwordFieldWriter
classes.responsibility: Struct writer storing four parameters into consecutive DWORD fields at +14/+18/+1C/+20 and returning the fourth. No read-back; the base is unknown and distinct from RectangleRegionState because common ownership is not proven.

classes.name: SentinelInitializedObject
classes.responsibility: Object constructed with vtable off_5ACAB0 at +0, a sub-object at dword index 9, zeroed fields at +4..+10 and +34/+3C, and -1 sentinel fields at +14..+20 and +38. Offsets 0x4..0x20 overlap ScrollOffsetState and RectangleRegionState fields, but common ownership is not proven and they are kept as separate bases.

classes.name: PostProcessInputState
classes.responsibility: Global race/post-process input state behind dword_7C54E0 exposing a championship-threshold source, a session-mode field, a circular time-slot index, a lap-time array, a debug suppression flag, and name/target object pointers consumed by the HUD text formatters. Field names are GUESS; the single global base is evidence.

classes.name: HudDebugTextFormatter
classes.responsibility: Family of HUD/debug text formatters that seed a caller buffer with a prefix string, conditionally read name/target/gap data from the post-process input object behind dword_7C54E0, and append formatted lap-time, gap, label, or threshold text via the safe string formatter.

classes.name: HudElementRenderer
classes.responsibility: HUD element renderer that formats a value into a stack buffer and renders it to a display resource at this+0x10 via the low-level render helper. Only the speed readout formatter is evidenced.

classes.name: VehicleGapUtility
classes.responsibility: Computes the time and lap gap between two vehicle objects by reading lap counters at +0x403C and per-vehicle time via a time sub-object at +12.

classes.name: RaceVehicle
classes.responsibility: Vehicle-like object evidenced only by the lap counter at +0x403C and an unnamed time sub-object at +12 consumed by gap computation. No packet function is a method of this object; fields are read cross-object.

interfaces.name: GapTextFormatter
interfaces.purpose: Behavioral contract for formatting a signed time or lap-count gap against a target object into a caller buffer; implemented by the two gap formatters that share the same callers (0x0049D700, 0x004DBB60).

interfaces.name: StringKeyedTableOperations
interfaces.purpose: Behavioral contract of a string-keyed bucket table: normalize a key, convert to a bucket index, and perform lookup/membership/insert over singly-linked nodes with the next link at +24.

compatibility_contracts.name: StringKeyedTableLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement string table must keep bucket heads at array base +0 and a next-node link at node+24; insert appends to the tail and the destructor drains exactly 26 buckets.

compatibility_contracts.name: IndexedListLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement indexed 16-bit list must keep the head at +0, a traversal cursor at +8, a length at +0xC, node data pointer at node+0 (two 16-bit values) and next-node link at node+4; index==length appends.

compatibility_contracts.name: ForwardingWrapperSemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: The three single-call forwarders must delegate their single argument to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and return the helper's result unchanged.

compatibility_contracts.name: LapGapCalculationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Gap computation: equal lap counts yield a signed time gap; a one-lap wrap with the leading time smaller yields flt_5EA408 - v7 + v9; otherwise an integer lap difference is emitted (decremented when the leading time is smaller); null input or behind-on-lap returns 1.

compatibility_contracts.name: HudTimeFormatContract
compatibility_contracts.description: HUD time formatters seed the buffer with a prefix string and append " MM:SS.FFF" only when the selected time float is positive.

unresolved: The callee StringCopyWithBufferRealloc is named in the source text but has no entry in the packet's callee list; its address, owner and buffer semantics are unknown.

Owner identities are not established for ZeroInitInt (0x0049A180), SevenFieldSentinelInit (0x0049A580) and ConditionalHeadStoreOrIterateAndSet (0x0049A1C0); the latter's chain-step sub_499E00 and the FieldSetterAt0x68 node field at +0x68 are not documented.

StringHashTable bucket-count (26, from the destructor) vs CharToIndexConversion's range are not proven to be the same array; the +4..+14 node fields written by PatternedFieldInit are never read inside this packet, so their role (flag array?) is unknown.
TwoChannel16BitReader (0x00499F00) gating via ShortComputation_adb0(this + 0x6C) > 2 and its ambiguous return value are not resolved; its owner assignment to IndexedListAccessor is GUESS.
IndexedListAccessor's +0xC field is ambiguous between length and capacity: the append path compares it against the length while the out-of-range path uses it as an upper bound.

RectangleRegionState, QuadDwordFieldWriter and SentinelInitializedObject overlap the same offsets (+0x14..+0x20 and +0x4..+0x10) across different callers; common ownership is NOT proven, so they are kept as separate bases rather than merged.

The postProcessInput label for dword_7C54E0 comes from existing analysis prose, not packet evidence; the meaning of its offsets (16448, 16552, 16484, 16592, 16596, 18168, 13004) and the 4656 ghost stride are inferred.

The global 0x007CE234 (DriverAppearanceFlag per the skeleton fill) is absent from the raw source of 0x0049D3F0, as are globals 0x0059E440, 0x005CCE24, 0x008ACEE0 (0x0049BFF0), 0x005CCE34/0x005CCE64 (0x0049C370), 0x005CCE44/0x005CCE78 (0x0049C4E0) and 0x005C3280 (0x0049C8A0); their roles are unresolved.
The constant return-0 on every path of the formatters is not evident as success/failure/void-like; LapTimeGapCalculation's time sub-object offset +12 has no dedicated field evidence reference.
String format literals (asc_5CCE18, asc_5CCE54, aS_6, a3d, word_5C694C, off_5CCE74 vs aLaps_0) are read from existing analysis; exact string contents are not verified in the packet.
